title: Common Rail Pressure Low Error 2
detail_of_failure: Pressure low error (level 2) is sensed in the supply pump.
controller_action: Operates the machine with the engine output limited.
related_information: • The signal voltage from the common rail pressure sensor can be checked with monitoring function (Code: 36401 (V)) • The common rail pressure sensed by the common rail pressure sensor can be checked with monitoring function (Code: 36400 (MPa)) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.cause: Low pressure error in the supply pump
steps.procedure: Do the troubleshooting for failure code [CA559].
